description: This file defines the GreaterThanOrEqualsOperator class, implementing comparison logic for API filtering operations in SuiteCRM. It extends a base Operator class and provides methods to return filter tags and SQL operators for 'greater than or equal to' comparisons, as well as validation logic for operators.
published: SuiteCRM ilters ilters ilters ilters ilter_operator

classes.name: GreaterThanOrEqualsOperator
classes.description: Implements the 'greater than or equal to' comparison operator for filtering in the API.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'gte' for 'greater than or equal to'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '>=' for 'greater than or equal to' comparison.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and delegates further validation to the parent class.
